title: fix: shorten dashboard announcements
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Puts the managed-agent announcement first without changing its copy.
- Condenses the new quests card while retaining all three launched rewards.
- Removes the obsolete "Quests are live" card and shortens the GPT-5.6 promotion.
- Adds a `3 new!` badge to the Quests navigation entry.
- Validated with Biome, Enter typecheck, and `git diff --check`.

gist.headline: Less scroll, more pollen
gist.blurb: The dashboard noticeboard got a small pruning. Managed agents now lead the way, fresh Quests are easier to spot, and the old sign has finally been taken down.
gist.summary: Reordered and condensed dashboard announcements, removed the obsolete "Quests are live" card, shortened the GPT-5.6 promotion, and added a "3 new!" badge to Quests navigation.
gist.impact: Dashboard visitors can spot managed agents and the three newly launched Quest rewards faster, with less announcement clutter.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cheerful garden keeper wearing a tiny tool belt, pruning an overgrown dashboard noticeboard into a neat set of short pinned cards. A prominently glowing Quests sign carries a small "3 new!" pixel badge, while three reward flowers bloom beneath it and a retro terminal card for managed agents sits at the top.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener tool belt, tidying a garden-like dashboard noticeboard: a managed-agents terminal card sits first, three Quest reward flowers bloom below a Quests sign with pixel-font text "3 new!", and an old card is gently composted beside the board. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, nature vines and code-plants, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
